title: Tool confirmations are not blocking for async subagents

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue requests a new feature and interactive capability allowing tool confirmations for async/backgrounded subagents to be non-blocking, including a way to close the confirmation queue, continue conversation with the primary agent, and return to confirmations later while the subagent is paused. This is a request for new functionality and workflow enhancement rather than a report of an existing bug or regression.
